candidates.title: Body donor dataset for mimic muscles
candidates.status: Real publicly downloadable muscle/bone segmentation masks acquired and inspected; not separately labeled missing muscles.
candidates.limitation: The authors deliberately segmented muscle groups and did not assign traditional individual facial-muscle boundaries. Raw CT/MRI intensities are not freely distributed. Group masks cannot prove the geometry of the nine missing muscle instances or ten missing part instances.
candidates.method_locator: Paper section 2.4 Segmentation and Figshare dataset description

example.name: 01.zip
example.ct_label_caution: These are not individual skull-bone labels. The two stored sform matrices differ in axis signs; do not overlay without registration review.

candidates.title: Functional Analysis of the Architecture of the Oro-facial and Hyoid Musculature: A Comparative 3D Modelling Study
candidates.author: Zhi Li, University of Toronto, 2015
candidates.relevance: Cadaveric digitizer study reports transversus menti and a right auricularis among reconstructed muscles.
candidates.status: Thesis located, but no reusable source mesh dataset or open geometry redistribution license found.
candidates.license: Thesis title page: copyright Zhi Li 2015; not a license to redistribute the underlying 3D model.
candidates.limitation: A figure, measured fibre count or 2D projection cannot reconstruct the unpublished 3D geometry. Auricularis is not resolved into all three required external-ear muscles by the table.

candidates.status: No separately named target muscles in the published segmentation list.
candidates.limitation: The list contains many facial muscles but no auricularis anterior/superior/posterior, depressor supercilii or transversus menti. Ear auricular cartilage is not ear muscle.

candidates.status: Same BodyParts3D-derived facial structures; no new target muscles or missing named parts.
candidates.limitation: Software animation and its simulated MRI/CT displays are not acquired imaging evidence.
